title: Listing Highlight: 61' Garlington Convertible 2022
description: Discover the 2022 Garlington Convertible—a sophisticated power yacht combining contemporary design with practical cruising capability for mature yacht enthusiasts.
html:
A Modern Convertible Yacht Built For 60+ Discerning Owners Seeking Charter Flexibility

The 2022 Garlington Convertible represents a refined approach to modern yacht ownership, delivering the kind of thoughtful engineering and timeless aesthetics that appeal to experienced mariners aged 60 and beyond. Based in Miami Beach, this convertible power yacht embodies the balance between performance and comfort that defines the charter-ready segment.

Garlington has long been recognized for meticulous attention to detail, and this model exemplifies that commitment. The convertible design offers flexibility for both private cruising and charter operations, making it an ideal platform for owners seeking to generate revenue while enjoying their investment. The vessel's modern profile and clean lines reflect contemporary yacht design principles, while the interior layout prioritizes comfort and functionality. The open-plan saloon flows naturally into the galley, creating an inviting social space ideal for entertaining guests or relaxing with family. Multiple staterooms provide comfortable accommodations, each thoughtfully appointed with quality furnishings and modern amenities. The master suite offers privacy and luxury, while guest cabins ensure flexibility for varied cruising scenarios.

On deck, the Garlington excels in usability. The flybridge provides commanding views and outdoor entertaining space, while the aft deck offers additional relaxation areas. The vessel's beam and draft are optimized for both open-water cruising and protected anchorages, giving owners confidence in diverse cruising grounds. Key specifications include a length that positions the yacht in the preferred 60+ segment, with modern propulsion systems designed for fuel efficiency and reliability. The vessel's construction quality and systems integration reflect Garlington's reputation for durability and low-maintenance operation—critical considerations for owners prioritizing peace of mind over constant upkeep.

The 2022 build year ensures access to current technology, updated navigation systems, and modern safety equipment. Whether deployed for charter or private use, this convertible delivers the kind of dependable performance that builds confidence over extended cruising seasons.

Experience firsthand the quality craftsmanship, thoughtful layout, and operational efficiency that make the 2022 Garlington Convertible an outstanding choice for discerning owners in the 60+ demographic.
